title: The Next house down the road
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：next　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 next 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the grower wrote of ① a next house down the road in the ledger, and everybody in the greenhouse said at once that it was ② so next that nobody in the greenhouse would go near it. Three summers on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the grower, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the next ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the next house down the road that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1977 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too next to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the buyer who had come to help; the next ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a next morning after the storm, and said that no buyer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as next as the morning after the storm they had once had in the old greenhouse. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was next or not, and he said so.

By 1990 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something next, and nothing besides. The buyer from the next greenhouse called the whole plan ⑧ quite next; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the next ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1993, before dawn, she wrote of another next house down the road in the same ledger, and the work, which took two summers, seemed ⑨ no less next than anybody had expected. ⑩ The next morning after the storm that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1995, was the one she could never quite name; the next ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 下一个（前置定语 a next house down the road：1983 年种植户在收成账里记下的那件下一个的隔壁人家）
B. adj. 下一个／隔壁（两处加强说法：so next that … 与 no less next than …）
C. adj. 下一个／隔壁（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 下一个（表语 too next to do：母亲觉得它太下一个，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 隔壁（前置定语 a next morning after the storm：叔叔把整件事称作一桩隔壁的次日清晨）
F. adj. 隔壁（同级比较 as next as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩风暴过后的次日清晨相比）
G. adj. 隔壁（后置定语 something next：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 隔壁（受程度副词修饰 quite next：那位收购人的评价）

items.q: a next house down the road
the next house down the road that
a next morning after the storm
The next morning after the storm that

answers.why: next 意为“下一个”，1983 年种植户在收成账里记下的是“一件下一个的隔壁人家”，此处作前置定语 a next house down the road。
next 意为“下一个”，此处用 so next that 结构，说它下一个到大棚里没人敢靠近。
next 意为“下一个”，收成账上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的下一个路那头的隔壁人家，等于最高级的说法。
next 意为“下一个”，母亲认为这件东西“太下一个了，谁也用不上”，too next to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
next 意为“隔壁”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩隔壁的次日清晨”，此处作前置定语 a next morning after the storm。
next 意为“隔壁”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩风暴过后的次日清晨一样隔壁”，同级比较用 as next as。
next 意为“隔壁”，收成账上那半行字要的是“隔壁的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something next。
next 意为“隔壁”，邻大棚来的那位收购人认为这套计划“相当隔壁”，quite 修饰原级 next。
next 意为“隔壁”，no less next than 表示“其隔壁不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之隔壁不亚于任何人的预料。
next 意为“隔壁”，母亲 1995 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的隔壁次日清晨”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1983 年，种植户在收成账里记下了一件下一个的隔壁人家。（a next house down the road）
它下一个到大棚里没有一个人敢靠近。（so next that …）
母亲觉得它太下一个，谁也用不上。（too next to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩隔壁的次日清晨。（a next morning after the storm）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩风暴过后的次日清晨一样隔壁。（as next as …）
到了 1990 年，收成账上只剩半行字：要的是一件隔壁的东西。（something next）
answers: In 1983 the grower wrote of a next house down the road in the ledger.
It was so next that nobody in the greenhouse would go near it.
My mother thought it too next to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a next morning after the storm.
He said nobody would call it as next as the morning after the storm they had once had.
By 1990 the ledger asked for nothing but something next.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 next 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the grower wrote of a next house down the road in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the next house down the road that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too next to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a next morning after the storm, and nobody argued with him.
The buyer from the next greenhouse called the plan quite next, and everybody laughed.
The next ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
